pound.desc: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

scratch.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe to inflict damage.

teleport.desc: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It may also be used to warp to the last Poké Center visited.

night-shade.desc: The user makes the foe see a mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.

mimic.desc: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used for the rest of the battle.

screech.desc: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

double-team.desc: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

recover.desc: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

harden.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

minimize.desc: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller. The user’s evasion stat is boosted.

smokescreen.desc: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the foe’s accuracy.

confuse-ray.desc: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

vice-grip.desc: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.

withdraw.desc: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

defense-curl.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

barrier.desc: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

light-screen.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

haze.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

reflect.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

focus-energy.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise the critical-hit ratio of its attacks.

bide.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

metronome.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.

mirror-move.desc: The user counters the foe by mimicking the move last used by the foe.

guillotine.desc: A vicious, tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint instantly if this attack hits.

self-destruct.desc: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

egg-bomb.desc: A large egg is hurled with maximum force at the foe to inflict damage.

lick.desc: The foe is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also paralyze the target.

smog.desc: The foe is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

sludge.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

bone-club.desc: The user clubs the foe with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.

fire-blast.desc: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

waterfall.desc: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

clamp.desc: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for two to five turns.

swift.desc: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

razor-wind.desc: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

skull-bash.desc: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.

spike-cannon.desc: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times in rapid succession.

constrict.desc: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed.

amnesia.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

kinesis.desc: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower the target’s accuracy.

soft-boiled.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. May be used in the field to heal HP.

high-jump-kick.desc: The foe is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

glare.desc: The user intimidates the foe with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

dream-eater.desc: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

poison-gas.desc: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the foe’s face. It may poison the target.

swords-dance.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

barrage.desc: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times in a row.

leech-life.desc: A blood-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

lovely-kiss.desc: With a scary face, the user forces a kiss on the foe. It may make the target fall asleep.

sky-attack.desc: A second-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also make the target flinch.

transform.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the foe right down to having the same move set.

bubble.desc: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

dizzy-punch.desc: The foe is hit with a rhythmically launched punch that may also leave it confused.

spore.desc: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

flash.desc: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

psywave.desc: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave. The attack varies in intensity.

cut.desc: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

splash.desc: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

acid-armor.desc: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

crabhammer.desc: The foe is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

explosion.desc: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

fury-swipes.desc: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

bonemerang.desc: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the foe twice, coming and going.

rest.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

rock-slide.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

hyper-fang.desc: The user bites hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.

sharpen.desc: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

gust.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.

conversion.desc: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

tri-attack.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three- beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

super-fang.desc: The user chomps hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.

slash.desc: The foe is attacked with a slash of claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

substitute.desc: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

sketch.desc: It enables the user to learn a move used by the foe. Once used, the move Sketch disappears.

triple-kick.desc: A consecutive three- kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

thief.desc: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

spider-web.desc: The user ensnares the foe with a thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.

wing-attack.desc: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

mind-reader.desc: The user senses the foe’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss.

nightmare.desc: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

flame-wheel.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. It may also leave the target with a burn.

snore.desc: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

curse.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

flail.desc: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

conversion-2.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack it last took.

aeroblast.desc: A vortex of air is shot at the foe to inflict damage. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

cotton-spore.desc: The user releases cottonlike spores that cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.

reversal.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

whirlwind.desc: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

spite.desc: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

powder-snow.desc: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the target.

protect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

mach-punch.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

scary-face.desc: The user frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed stat.

feint-attack.desc: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

sweet-kiss.desc: The user kisses the foe with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

belly-drum.desc: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

sludge-bomb.desc: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.

mud-slap.desc: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

fly.desc: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

octazooka.desc: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe’s feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

zap-cannon.desc: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

foresight.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

destiny-bond.desc: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.

perish-song.desc: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns unless it switches out of battle.

icy-wind.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

detect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

bone-rush.desc: The user strikes at the foe with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

lock-on.desc: The user takes sure aim at the foe. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

karate-chop.desc: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

bind.desc: A long body or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.

outrage.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

sandstorm.desc: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock, Ground, and Steel.

giga-drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

endure.desc: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

charm.desc: The user charmingly stares at the foe, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is sharply lowered.

rollout.desc: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

false-swipe.desc: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

swagger.desc: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

milk-drink.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP.

spark.desc: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the foe. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

slam.desc: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

fury-cutter.desc: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

steel-wing.desc: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

mean-look.desc: The user affixes the foe with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

attract.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

sleep-talk.desc: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

heal-bell.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

return.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

present.desc: The user attacks by giving the foe a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.

frustration.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

safeguard.desc: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

vine-whip.desc: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

pain-split.desc: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the foe.

sacred-fire.desc: The foe is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

magnitude.desc: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone in battle. Its power varies.

dynamic-punch.desc: The foe is punched with the user’s full, concentrated power. It confuses the foe if it hits.

megahorn.desc: Utilizing its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the foe with no letup.

dragon-breath.desc: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also paralyze the target.

baton-pass.desc: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

encore.desc: The user compels the foe to keep using only the move it last used for two to six turns.

pursuit.desc: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a foe that is switching out of battle.

rapid-spin.desc: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

stomp.desc: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

sweet-scent.desc: A sweet scent that lowers the foe’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

iron-tail.desc: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

metal-claw.desc: The foe is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

vital-throw.desc: The user allows the foe to attack first. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

morning-sun.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

synthesis.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moonlight.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

hidden-power.desc: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

cross-chop.desc: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

twister.desc: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

double-kick.desc: The foe is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

rain-dance.desc: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

sunny-day.desc: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

crunch.desc: The user crunches up the foe with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

mirror-coat.desc: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

psych-up.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

extreme-speed.desc: The user charges the foe at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

ancient-power.desc: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

shadow-ball.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

future-sight.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked with a hunk of psychic energy.

rock-smash.desc: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

mega-kick.desc: The foe is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

whirlpool.desc: The user traps the foe inside a fast, vicious whirlpool that lasts for two to five turns.

beat-up.desc: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

fake-out.desc: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. This move works only on the first turn.

uproar.desc: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

stockpile.desc: The user charges up power, and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

spit-up.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack.

swallow.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

heat-wave.desc: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

hail.desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

torment.desc: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

jump-kick.desc: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

flatter.desc: Flattery is used to confuse the foe. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

will-o-wisp.desc: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

memento.desc: The user faints upon using this move. In return, it sharply lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.

facade.desc: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

focus-punch.desc: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

smelling-salts.desc: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the foe’s paralysis, however.

follow-me.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all foes take aim only at the user.

nature-power.desc: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

charge.desc: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

taunt.desc: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

rolling-kick.desc: The user cuts a quick spin and lashes out with a sharp kick.

helping-hand.desc: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

trick.desc: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

role-play.desc: The user mimics the foe completely, copying the foe’s natural ability.

wish.desc: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP in the next turn.

assist.desc: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

ingrain.desc: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

superpower.desc: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

magic-coat.desc: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

recycle.desc: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

revenge.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

sand-attack.desc: Sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.

brick-break.desc: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

yawn.desc: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

knock-off.desc: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

endeavor.desc: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

eruption.desc: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

skill-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

imprison.desc: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

refresh.desc: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

grudge.desc: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the foe’s move that knocked it out.

snatch.desc: The user steals the effects of any healing or status- changing move the foe attempts to use.

headbutt.desc: The user sticks its head out and rams straight forward. It may make the foe flinch.

secret-power.desc: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

dive.desc: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

arm-thrust.desc: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

camouflage.desc: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.

tail-glow.desc: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, sharply raising its Sp. Atk stat.

luster-purge.desc: The user looses a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

mist-ball.desc: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk.

feather-dance.desc: The user covers the foe with a mass of down that sharply lowers the Attack stat.

teeter-dance.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses all the Pokémon in battle.

blaze-kick.desc: The user launches a kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also leave the target with a burn.

double-slap.desc: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

horn-attack.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

mud-sport.desc: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric- type moves while the user is in the battle.

ice-ball.desc: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

needle-arm.desc: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.

slack-off.desc: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

hyper-voice.desc: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

poison-fang.desc: The user bites the foe with toxic fangs. It may also leave the foe badly poisoned.

crush-claw.desc: The user slashes the foe with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target’s Defense.

blast-burn.desc: The foe is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

hydro-cannon.desc: The foe is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

meteor-mash.desc: The foe is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user’s Attack.

fury-attack.desc: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

astonish.desc: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

weather-ball.desc: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

aromatherapy.desc: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user’s party.

fake-tears.desc: The user feigns crying to make the foe feel flustered, sharply lowering its Sp. Def stat.

air-cutter.desc: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

overheat.desc: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

odor-sleuth.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

rock-tomb.desc: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

silver-wind.desc: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

metal-sound.desc: A horrible sound like scraping metal is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

horn-drill.desc: The foe is stabbed with a horn rotating like a drill. The foe instantly faints if it hits.

grass-whistle.desc: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the foe into a deep sleep.

tickle.desc: The user tickles the foe into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

cosmic-power.desc: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

water-spout.desc: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful it becomes.

signal-beam.desc: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

shadow-punch.desc: The user throws a punch at the foe from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

extrasensory.desc: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the foe flinch.

sky-uppercut.desc: The user attacks the foe with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

sand-tomb.desc: The user traps the foe inside a harshly raging sandstorm for two to five turns.

sheer-cold.desc: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The foe instantly faints if it hits.

tackle.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

muddy-water.desc: The user attacks by shooting out muddy water. It may also lower the foe’s accuracy.

bullet-seed.desc: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

aerial-ace.desc: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

icicle-spear.desc: The user launches sharp icicles at the foe. It strikes two to five times in a row.

iron-defense.desc: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

block.desc: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

howl.desc: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

dragon-claw.desc: The user slashes the foe with huge, sharp claws.

frenzy-plant.desc: The foe is slammed with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

bulk-up.desc: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

body-slam.desc: The user drops onto the foe with its full body weight. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

bounce.desc: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

mud-shot.desc: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the foe. It also reduces the target’s Speed.

poison-tail.desc: An attack with a high critical-hit ratio. This tail attack may also poison the foe.

covet.desc: The user endearingly approaches the foe, then steals the item the foe is holding.

volt-tackle.desc: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

magical-leaf.desc: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the foe. This attack will not miss.

water-sport.desc: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

calm-mind.desc: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

leaf-blade.desc: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

dragon-dance.desc: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

wrap.desc: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.

rock-blast.desc: The user hurls hard rocks at the foe. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

shock-wave.desc: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

water-pulse.desc: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

doom-desire.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the foe with a concentrated bundle of light.

psycho-boost.desc: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

roost.desc: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

gravity.desc: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

miracle-eye.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

wake-up-slap.desc: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.

hammer-arm.desc: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

take-down.desc: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

gyro-ball.desc: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

healing-wish.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

brine.desc: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

natural-gift.desc: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

feint.desc: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

pluck.desc: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tailwind.desc: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

acupressure.desc: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

metal-burst.desc: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.

u-turn.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

thrash.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

close-combat.desc: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

payback.desc: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

assurance.desc: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

embargo.desc: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

fling.desc: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

psycho-shift.desc: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

trump-card.desc: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.

heal-block.desc: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

wring-out.desc: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

power-trick.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

double-edge.desc: A reckless, life- risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

gastro-acid.desc: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

lucky-chant.desc: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

me-first.desc: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

copycat.desc: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

power-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.

guard-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.

punishment.desc: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

last-resort.desc: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

worry-seed.desc: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

sucker-punch.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

tail-whip.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe less wary. The target’s Defense stat is lowered.

toxic-spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

heart-swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.

aqua-ring.desc: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

magnet-rise.desc: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

flare-blitz.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.

force-palm.desc: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

aura-sphere.desc: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

rock-polish.desc: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

poison-jab.desc: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

dark-pulse.desc: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

comet-punch.desc: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

poison-sting.desc: The foe is stabbed with a poisonous barb of some sort. It may also poison the target.

night-slash.desc: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

aqua-tail.desc: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

seed-bomb.desc: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

air-slash.desc: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

x-scissor.desc: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

bug-buzz.desc: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

dragon-pulse.desc: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

dragon-rush.desc: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

power-gem.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

drain-punch.desc: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

twineedle.desc: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.

vacuum-wave.desc: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

focus-blast.desc: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

energy-ball.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

brave-bird.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

earth-power.desc: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

switcheroo.desc: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

giga-impact.desc: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

nasty-plot.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

bullet-punch.desc: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

avalanche.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

pin-missile.desc: Sharp pins are shot at the foe in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

ice-shard.desc: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

shadow-claw.desc: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

thunder-fang.desc: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

ice-fang.desc: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

fire-fang.desc: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

shadow-sneak.desc: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.

mud-bomb.desc: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

psycho-cut.desc: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

zen-headbutt.desc: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

mirror-shot.desc: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

leer.desc: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

flash-cannon.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

rock-climb.desc: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

defog.desc: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

trick-room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

draco-meteor.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

discharge.desc: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

lava-plume.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.

leaf-storm.desc: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

power-whip.desc: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

rock-wrecker.desc: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

bite.desc: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

cross-poison.desc: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

gunk-shot.desc: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

iron-head.desc: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

magnet-bomb.desc: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.

stone-edge.desc: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

captivate.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

stealth-rock.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

grass-knot.desc: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

chatter.desc: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.

judgment.desc: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

growl.desc: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

bug-bite.desc: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

charge-beam.desc: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

wood-hammer.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

aqua-jet.desc: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

attack-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

defend-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to make a living shield, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

heal-order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

head-smash.desc: The user delivers a life-endangering head butt at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.

double-hit.desc: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

roar-of-time.desc: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

roar.desc: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

spacial-rend.desc: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

lunar-dance.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

crush-grip.desc: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.

magma-storm.desc: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.

dark-void.desc: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.

seed-flare.desc: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

ominous-wind.desc: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

shadow-force.desc: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.

sing.desc: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the foe into a deep slumber.

supersonic.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

sonic-boom.desc: The foe is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

mega-punch.desc: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

disable.desc: For several turns, this move prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

acid.desc: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ember.desc: The foe is attacked with small flames. The target may also be left with a burn.

flamethrower.desc: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

mist.desc: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

water-gun.desc: The foe is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

hydro-pump.desc: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

surf.desc: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

ice-beam.desc: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

blizzard.desc: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

pay-day.desc: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.

psybeam.desc: The foe is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also leave the target confused.

bubble-beam.desc: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

aurora-beam.desc: The foe is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. It may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

hyper-beam.desc: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

peck.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

drill-peck.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

submission.desc: The user grabs the foe and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

low-kick.desc: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

counter.desc: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

seismic-toss.desc: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

fire-punch.desc: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

strength.desc: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

absorb.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

mega-drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

leech-seed.desc: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.

growth.desc: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

razor-leaf.desc: A sharp-edged leaf is launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

solar-beam.desc: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

poison-powder.desc: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered on the foe. It may poison the target.

stun-spore.desc: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may paralyze the target.

sleep-powder.desc: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep- inducing dust around the foe.

ice-punch.desc: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

petal-dance.desc: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

string-shot.desc: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.

dragon-rage.desc: The foe is stricken by a shock wave. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

fire-spin.desc: The foe becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for two to five turns.

thunder-shock.desc: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

thunderbolt.desc: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

thunder-wave.desc: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

thunder.desc: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

rock-throw.desc: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the foe to attack.

earthquake.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

thunder-punch.desc: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

fissure.desc: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

dig.desc: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

toxic.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

confusion.desc: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.

psychic.desc: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

hypnosis.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

meditate.desc: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

agility.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

quick-attack.desc: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

rage.desc: While this move is in use, it gains attack power each time the user is hit in battle.

struggle.desc: An attack that is used when no other move has PP left.
